title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta13

## Prevent active-mowing vendor trail render starvation

This beta hardens the persistent current-cycle vendor trail pipeline so a rapidly advancing vendor geometry revision cannot keep the Map API waiting for a perfectly stable snapshot.

- Treat ZoneLedger cycle identity, not vendor geometry revision, as the authority for whether an in-flight current-cycle SVG is still valid.
- Allow a completed SVG for an older geometry revision to become the last-known-good artifact when newer geometry arrives during rendering, provided the zone remains in the same confirmed cycle.
- Keep rebuilding toward the newest geometry on later requests; same-cycle prefixes are temporary, valid render states rather than discarded work.
- Continue to reject in-flight artifacts across a confirmed reset/new cycle, so geometry from the previous cycle cannot reappear.
- Keep sticky per-zone vendor ownership, MQTT live-tail semantics and History archives unchanged.
- Add regression coverage for same-cycle geometry advances during SVG generation and for reset-sensitive cycle identity.

This is the integration half of the active-mowing starvation fix. A companion Map Card update can use stable cycle identity instead of geometry revisions when accepting deferred current-cycle renders.
